item.title: The Next Phase of AI Coding: Rebuilding the SDLC
item.author: blog@baifan.site (ByF (BaiFan))
item.description: Two years in, everyone on the team writes code several times faster than before. Delivery hasn’t gotten faster. After post-mortems on enough projects, the conclusion converged into one sentence: the bottleneck didn’t disappear — it moved from the editor into the review queue and the verification pipeline. This post lays out the judgments we’ve mined over two years. The last one is directional: the next phase of AI coding is rebuilding the engineering system itself.
